The '''Number 3 Supply Dump''' was a [[Smugglers' Alliance]] supply dump located at 412 [[Wozwashi Street]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].

==History==
This supply dump was one of the buildings owned by the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] on Rishi. [[Lachton]] was assigned there after the evacuation of Karrde's main [[Myrkr Base|base]] on Myrkr. Like the [[Rishi Base (Talon Karrde)|Rishi Base]], the supply dump was probably abandoned after the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gunner Groth]] discovered the presence of Karrde's [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on the planet.
